show.title: Shoorveer Ka Aagaman
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/hW6bWV
show.description: After living in hiding for 12 years as a humble laborer to protect his daughter, Surya, the legendary legendary "Shoorveer" of Veeram Palace, is forced back into action when corrupt elites brutally bully and kidnap her. He dismantles a powerful criminal conspiracy involving four elite families and the villainous "Master" from his past, ultimately reclaiming his mythical status to deliver absolute justice.
